# Nibbables

> Long-lasting dog chews, compared by what each brand actually says. A directory of long-lasting dog chews (bully sticks, yak cheese chews, beef cheek rolls, rawhide-free chews and antlers) that quotes each brand's own product page.

Each product card quotes the brand's own page word for word (ingredients, made-in and sourcing wording, size guidance, supervision notes), links that page and shows the date it was checked. Made-in and sourcing statements are the brands' claims, not independently verified. Missing facts are marked "Not stated, check with them". Nibbables shows no prices, reviews, star ratings or safety ratings, and it is not veterinary advice. Some product cards have Amazon Associates and/or CJ Affiliate (Raw Paws) links; see the About page for the disclosure.

## Guides

- [Bully stick vs beef tendon: what 5 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-beef-tendon/): Bully sticks vs beef tendon chews from the same 5 brands: ingredients, origin, calories and shelf life quoted from each page, plus what the AKC says.

- [Bully stick vs collagen stick: what 3 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-collagen-stick/): Bully stick vs collagen stick from the same 3 brands: ingredients, origin, calories, protein and chewer wording quoted from each page, plus vet sources.
- [Bully stick vs gullet stick: what 7 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-gullet-stick/): Bully sticks vs gullet sticks (beef esophagus) from the same 7 brands: ingredients, origin, calories and chewer wording quoted from each brand's page.
- [Bully stick vs rawhide: what vets and 14 brands say](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-rawhide/): Bully sticks vs rawhide for dogs: how vet sources define each, and what 14 bully stick brands' pages say about rawhide, quoted. Are bully sticks rawhide?
- [Bully stick vs yak chew: ingredients, origin, calories](https://nibbables.com/bully-stick-vs-yak-chew/): Bully stick vs yak chew, side by side: ingredients, where made and calories as 14 brand pages state them, plus what the AKC and a vet journal say about each.
- [Bully sticks made in the USA: what 18 brand pages say](https://nibbables.com/bully-sticks-made-in-usa/): Which bully sticks say they're made or sourced in the USA? 18 brand pages quoted word for word, from made-and-sourced to packaged-only, plus the FTC rule.
- [Collagen sticks & pancreatitis: fat % by brand | Nibbables](https://nibbables.com/collagen-sticks-and-pancreatitis/): Can dogs with pancreatitis eat collagen sticks? Fat and calorie lines from 9 collagen pages, plus Tufts and AAFCO notes on fat. Ask your vet.
- [Do bully sticks go bad? Shelf life and storage](https://nibbables.com/how-long-do-bully-sticks-last/): Bully stick shelf life, storage and when to take one away, quoted from 18 brand product pages plus Redbarn, Natural Farm and FDA guidance.
- [Himalayan dog chew microwave times: what 7 sources say](https://nibbables.com/yak-chew-microwave/): Yak chew microwave instructions from Himalayan Dog Chew, Yak Chewz, Mighty Paw, Pawstruck, YAKERS, Yakkity Zac's and Whole Dog Journal: soak, time, cooling.
- [Yak chews and pancreatitis: fat % by brand, vet notes](https://nibbables.com/yak-chews-and-pancreatitis/): Can dogs with pancreatitis eat yak chews? The fat and calorie lines on 8 yak chew pages, what Tufts vet nutritionists say about fat, and what to ask your vet.
